messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Periodograms
parts:
Hi Shauhin.

I haven't coded this into ctmm.select() or summary() yet, but from what I've been finding, I would use AIC/BIC only to choose between autocorrelation models given a fixed mean model and the MSPE to choose between different mean models given a fixed autocorrelation model.

https://ctmm-initiative.github.io/ctmm/articles/periodogram.html

You have another problem, though, which is optim(). Fitting the telemetry error, like you are doing, you might not reach MLE on the first try, so I would recommend refitting from the first fit (as the second guess) to make sure it doesn't improve. One of those fits probably hit the MLE on the first try and the other didn't.
The two optimizers I would recommend are the default optim Nelder-Mead and ctmm's beta optimizer referenced in the periodogram vignette. Neither are 100% reliable, but Mike says he finds more success with the beta optimizer in the latest versions of the package, especially if you give it a lot of cores.

Best,
Chris
